selection_protocol.description: A small, frozen multi-host corpus of public repositories that ship telemetry/log data and were authored without this tool in mind. Each subject is pinned to an exact commit SHA so the study is replayable byte-for-byte.
criteria: public repository on github.com, gitlab.com, or bitbucket.org
ships at least one parseable telemetry/log file in a recognised format
authored independently of this project (no contract or convention adoption)
selection_protocol.notes: This tier-1 set is intentionally tiny so it runs quickly in network-gated CI. Larger tiers can be appended without changing the schema.

subjects.rationale: ships JSONL application logs under logs/
independent GitLab sample project (no-telemetry graceful path)
independent Bitbucket sample project (no-telemetry graceful path)
